keyword: education department calculation changes make public service loan forgiveness harder for borrowers
claims: The SAVE plan has been eliminated.
Borrowers can no longer use lower, subsidized payments from the suspended SAVE plan to calculate their PSLF buyback payments.
PSLF buybacks are used to turn non-qualifying months into qualifying ones.

The Department of Education is requesting new income and family size documentation for buyback calculations made on or after July 1, 2024, if the borrower was not already on an IBR, PAYE, or ICR plan.
There are over 88,000 pending PSLF applications as of Feb 2026.
There is a new Tiered Standard Plan.
